description: A temperature spike scenario crosses Warning then Critical then clears; the stream emits the matching threshold alerts and the MetricReport tracks the value
twin:
[twin]
tick_interval_seconds = 5

[[twin.binding]]
path = "/redfish/v1/Chassis/GPU_0/Sensors/Temp0"
pointer = "/Reading"
source = "scenario"
scenario = "spike"
metric = "GpuTemperature"
warning = 60.0
critical = 90.0

[[scenario]]
name = "spike"
[[scenario.segment]]
kind = "nominal"
value = 20.0
for_s = 10
[[scenario.segment]]
kind = "drift"
value = 100.0
for_s = 10
[[scenario.segment]]
kind = "drift"
value = 20.0
for_s = 10
[[scenario.segment]]
kind = "nominal"
value = 20.0

steps.name: crossing the warning band at t=15 emits a Warning alert
peak at t=20 emits a Critical alert and the report reads 100
returning to nominal by t=35 clears the alert
